scope: Public-play golf courses in all 50 US states and DC; incomplete, ongoing acquisition.
record_unit: One named source-listed course or golf facility. Holes are its published total, so 27/36 may comprise multiple layouts; totals are not invented rounds.
public_access_basis: Explicit Public classification or owner/government statement welcoming public/nonmember golf. Private and unverified semi-private/resort facilities are excluded.
address_basis: Published course or mailing address; city-only listings remain null. Not a verified driving entrance.
freshness: Observed on updated_on; source publication dates are often unknown. No claim of real-time operating status.
county_basis: County of an exact Census address match or an explicit primary-source county statement, not proof of the entire course footprint. Missing/ambiguous matches remain null.
rights: Independently structured bare facts with citations; no source prose, photographs, maps or scorecard artwork copied. No third-party website license asserted.

state_intake_notes.IA: Association Public-labelled member facilities, NGA Iowa listings and county gap additions; not all Iowa public courses.
state_intake_notes.NE: 127 Nebraska facilities in association Public filter; unverified Semi-private excluded.
state_intake_notes.ND: Partial intake: 20 of 93 Public-labelled directory entries before collector interruption.
state_intake_notes.CA: NCGA explicit-Public inventory with flagged stale entries excluded; SCGA-only access requires separate operator/government confirmation.
state_intake_notes.GA: Association Public labels plus owner-confirmed public play; missing hole counts stay null.
state_intake_notes.TN: Association Public labels; owner hole-count checks underway.

coverage.county_gap_search: State inventory intake does not establish county completeness. County searches are incomplete, and no result does not establish no public courses.
